visual_appeal: Raise all secondary copy from the muddy grey-brown to #C8BBA4 so the dashboard matches the cream/gold of his real windows.
Remove the moon glyphs from the default row (keep the hover explanation on the chip only); they are a second status system fighting the rail and the chip.
Replace the hero's inline 'Water's conjured' tag with a real bubble: max-width 280px, 12px padding, fill #1A140E, 1px #8A7040 border, sitting fully above the name.
state_colours: Make the left rail 6px, full row height, using full #3DDC7A, nearly #E6C84A, resting #E8943A, not-resting #E04B4B, max #6E6A66.
Mix class-coloured names 40% toward #F0E6D2 so warrior brown and max-level grey do not outrank the state chip; keep class hue only as a tint.
Paint the now-playing remaining-XP bar in that same state hue at 80% instead of the generic blue-grey.
character_identity: Bump row portraits from ~28px to 36px with a 2px class-colour ring so the similar Forsaken faces separate.
Put a 14px class icon immediately before each row name; do not add race/class text (it would ellipsize the place).
Use the card's speech-bubble component on the hero, with an 8px tail aimed at the portrait, not a one-line caption colliding with 'Level 22'.
default_theme: One secondary button only: face #6B4E2E, 1px border #C4A574, label #F4E8C8, height 26px. Compact currently reads blue-steel like ElvUI's Defaults; no blue in the default theme.
Title 15px #F0D890, 1px shadow #000000 at 40% opacity, centred like the Character window title.
Fill #100C09, outer border 1px #3A2A1C, 8px bronze studs at the four corners only.
elvui_wc3_fit: Match the Options window, not a decorated door: fill #0E0C0A, 1px border #2A241C, corner studs 4px #8A7048. Drop the extra inner stroke and the illustrated hero vignette; use the flat panel behind Controls.
Compact must be the same blue enamel as Defaults: face #1E4F86, top highlight #3D7EC4, height 22px, cream label.
Title 14px #F0D890, same weight as 'Controls' / 'Le Jette'. Close X 16px red enamel, identical hit size to the Character window X.
alerts_ux: Make Up next an obvious 28px button, min-width 160px, label 'Open Le Nette' (theme bronze or ElvUI blue), not a quiet name chip.
On the esc menu, anchor the alert 8px under the Log Out row at the menu width (~280px) with a 1px upward tick so it reads as about logout.
Drop the unlabeled gear or replace it with 13px 'Options'. Keep the dismiss target 20px. Body 13px #F4E8C8, second line 12px #C8BBA4, left accent 4px #E04B4B.
readability: Floor every string at 12px. Row sublines ('Lv 19 · Thunder Bluff · 3d ago', 'none used this session', 'Synced 2d ago') at 12px #C4B8A4, not #7A7368.
Bar captions, 'levels banked', and toast body at 13-14px. Speech at 14px #F4E8C8.
Force name contrast: warrior #E0C090, max-level grey #D0D0D0, plus a 1px #000000 outline at 50%. Target 4.5:1 on every gold-on-brown pair.
layout_polish: Hero cluster: 12px gap between the #1 disc and the portrait ring; the speech bubble's baseline must clear 'Level 22' by 8px.
Optically centre the 1.7 on the bar's right edge and put 8px between it and 'levels banked'. Chips a fixed 88px wide so 'NEARLY FULL' matches 'FULL'.
Card tidbit icon-to-label gap 8px, row height 22px. Window padding 16px; 8px between the now-playing strip and the NEXT BEST band.
delight: Card bubble needs an 8px tail into the portrait and a 12px italic #E8DCC0 emote under it ('yawns', 'shivers') so the stage reads as a character, not a stat card.
Toast: 40px portrait, 15px 'Play Le Nette', the '1.7 levels banked' line in #7DDE8A. That moment is the product; it should be louder than the dashboard.
First-run step numbers as 20px gold discs on #6B4E2E so the empty state feels as finished as the roster.

overall_notes: Play-next is the part that already ships: #1, the sorted roster, the red outside-rest pill, and 'hearth, then play Le Nette' are unambiguous. The rest is a strong 8. ElvUI mode is close to his real near-black panels but still a notch more ornamented than Options/Character, and the default Compact button still looks like ElvUI blue. Secondary type is too dim, moons duplicate the chips, and the hero speech is a cramped tag instead of the card's bubble. Fix contrast, one button family per theme, and the hero cluster before this is a 9 for a demanding ElvUI user.
